structured_output.what_is_happening: STEVE (SteveWillDoIt) is a 16-minute-old PumpSwap pool that did not come from a bonding curve (migrated_unix=0). The creator seems to have seeded it directly with large liquidity: $197k liquidity against a $129k market cap, 73.7% of supply sits in the pool, and the LP is 100% unlocked. It is one of about 10 copycat tokens riding a SteveWillDoIt moment. That moment looks tied to UsePaid, a new service that pairs a pump.fun token with an X handle and sends fees to that person. The token's own description links to a different token's UsePaid page (3pVv..., STEVEWILLDOIT, about $459k mcap, launched roughly an hour earlier). That makes 3pVv the more likely canonical token and this one a derivative. Flow is dominated by bots: 565 unique buyers but only 53 unique sellers making about 1,060 sells, 50 GMGN bundler wallets (22.5% of top-trader share), and the linked X account has been renamed 4 times.

narrative.description: SteveWillDoIt, a well-known YouTuber and influencer (he previously had the $HERO token), combined with the new UsePaid 'pair a pump.fun token to an X handle' mechanic launched mid-September 2026. Multiple SteveWillDoIt tokens appeared within the last hour.
narrative.why_spreading: A famous name plus a fresh UsePaid meta in which tokens tied to X handles pay fees to the influencer. Several same-name tokens are drawing volume ($800k to $1.3M per hour on rivals).

token_connection.why_this_token: Its description copies and links the UsePaid page of 3pVv (STEVEWILLDOIT), so it has no UsePaid pairing of its own. It is a derivative that captured volume through its short $STEVE ticker and deep seeded pool.

authenticity.evidence: The creator seeded a PumpSwap pool without a bonding curve, and the LP is 100% unlocked. 50 bundler wallets hold 22.5% of top-trader share. 53 unique sellers made about 1,060 sells, which points to wash/bot selling. The X link goes to a 4-times-renamed account (intelligentdog9) and the Telegram link is UsePaid's own channel.
